Home.tagline: An Egyptian platform for pharmacists: jobs, professional verification and opportunities in one place.

Meta.title: Pharmacist Platform
Meta.description: An Arabic-first platform for pharmacists in Egypt.

Email.footer: This is an automated message from Pharmacist Platform. Please do not reply.

verification.subject: Confirm your email - Pharmacist Platform
verification.heading: Confirm your email
verification.body: Thanks for signing up. Open the link below to confirm your email address. The link is valid for 24 hours.
verification.ignore: If you did not create an account on Pharmacist Platform, ignore this message.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password - Pharmacist Platform
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: You asked to reset your password. Open the link below to choose a new one. The link is valid for one hour, works once, and signs you out on every device.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message; your current password stays the same.

accountExists.subject: Sign-up attempt with your email - Pharmacist Platform
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to create a new account with this email address, but you already have one. If it was you, sign in, or reset your password if you forgot it.
accountExists.ignore: If it was not you, ignore this message; nothing changed in your account.

Common.passwordHint: 10 to 128 characters. A long, memorable phrase works best.
Common.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

AuthErrors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
AuthErrors.emailNotVerified: Your email is not confirmed yet. We sent you a new confirmation link; open your inbox, then try again.
AuthErrors.passwordTooShort: The password is too short; use at least 10 characters.
AuthErrors.passwordTooLong: The password is too long; use at most 128 characters.
AuthErrors.passwordCompromised: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
AuthErrors.invalidToken: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used.
AuthErrors.invalidCode: The code is incorrect. Check the current code in your authenticator app.
AuthErrors.invalidBackupCode: The backup code is incorrect or was already used.
AuthErrors.twoFactorExpired: The verification step timed out. Sign in again.
AuthErrors.twoFactorTooManyAttempts: Too many incorrect attempts. Sign in again to get a new attempt.
AuthErrors.accountLocked: Two-step verification is paused after too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
AuthErrors.sessionNotFresh: To protect your account, sign in again and retry.
AuthErrors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
AuthErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a little, then try again.
AuthErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
AuthErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.

SignUp.title: Create an account
SignUp.intro: Sign up with your email. We will send you a link to confirm it.

CheckEmail.title: Check your email
CheckEmail.body: If this email can be registered, a message will arrive within minutes. Open the link in it to confirm your email; it is valid for 24 hours. Check your spam folder too.
CheckEmail.resent: If there is an unconfirmed account with this email, we sent a new link.

VerifyEmail.title: Confirm email
VerifyEmail.success: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
VerifyEmail.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
VerifyEmail.missing: The link is incomplete. Open the full link from the email.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.passwordReset: Your password was changed and you were signed out on every device. Sign in with the new password.
SignIn.totpIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

ForgotPassword.title: Forgot password
ForgotPassword.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sent: If there is an account with this email, a message will arrive within minutes. The link is valid for one hour.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.intro: After saving, you will be signed out on every device.
ResetPassword.missing: The link is incomplete. Open the full link from the email.

Account.title: My account

notices.staff_denied: You do not have access to the staff area.
notices.staff_mfa_required: The staff area requires two-step verification: turn it on, then sign in with it.

Account.totpExplain: Asks for a code from an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) at every sign-in. Required for staff.
Account.setupStep1: 1. Add the account to your authenticator app: open the link on your phone, or enter the key manually.
Account.setupStep2: 2. Store the backup codes somewhere safe. Each works once and they will not be shown again.
Account.setupStep3: 3. Enter the current code from the app to finish.
Account.signOutEverywhereConfirm: You will be signed out on this device and all others. Continue?
Account.dataExplain: Download a copy of your account and profile data as JSON.
Account.verificationExplain: Verify that you are a pharmacist or pharmacy student to show a “Verified” badge on your profile.
Account.organizationsExplain: Your pharmacy or chain, its members and invitations.
Account.applicationsExplain: The jobs you applied to and where each application stands.

Staff.title: Staff area
Staff.body: Staff tools arrive with the admin step. Your access is protected by two-step verification.

Profile.title: My profile
Profile.intro: Your public profile is shown to signed-in members only, never to search engines. Private details are visible to you alone.
Profile.empty: You have not created your profile yet. Fill in the details below and save.
Profile.viewPublic: View my profile as members see it
Profile.profileExplain: Signed-in members see this when your profile is visible.
Profile.displayNameHint: 2 to 80 characters, in Arabic or English.
Profile.headlineHint: For example: community pharmacist, or fourth-year pharmacy student. Up to 120 characters.
Profile.yearsHint: A number from 0 to 60. Arabic digits are fine.
Profile.visibilityLegend: Who can see my public profile

visibilityHints.members: Any signed-in member can see it.
visibilityHints.hidden: No other member can see it.

Profile.detailsExplain: Only you can see these. They will be used later only when you apply for a job.
Profile.experienceExplain: Shown with your public profile. Up to 30 entries.
Profile.experienceEmpty: You have not added any experience yet.
Profile.experienceLimit: You have reached the limit of 30 entries. Delete one to add another.
Profile.deleteConfirm: Delete this experience? This cannot be undone.

ProfileErrors.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number, in Arabic or Western digits.
ProfileErrors.outOfRange: This number is outside the allowed range.
ProfileErrors.invalidChoice: Choose a value from the list.
ProfileErrors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid 11-digit Egyptian mobile number starting with 010, 011, 012 or 015.
ProfileErrors.inFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
ProfileErrors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
ProfileErrors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
ProfileErrors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
ProfileErrors.notFound: We could not find this entry; it may already be deleted. Refresh the page.
ProfileErrors.limitReached: You have reached the limit of 30 entries. Delete one to add another.
ProfileErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
ProfileErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

ProfileView.title: Professional profile
ProfileView.ownerNotice: This is a preview of your profile as members see it.
ProfileView.hiddenNotice: Your profile is hidden. No one else can see it.
ProfileView.yearsExperience: {count, plural, =0 {Less than a year of experience} one {# year of experience} other {# years of experience}}

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: We could not find what you are looking for. The link may be wrong or no longer available.

UploadErrors.forbidden: You cannot upload files from here. Confirm your email address, then try again from this site.
UploadErrors.too_large: The photo is larger than 8 MB. Choose a smaller one.
UploadErrors.unsupported_type: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP photos are accepted.
UploadErrors.rate_limited: Too many uploads in the last hour. Try again later.
UploadErrors.too_many_pending: Wait until your earlier photos finish processing, then try again.
UploadErrors.unavailable: Uploads are unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.

rejected.infected: The photo was refused because the security check flagged it.
rejected.undecodable: The photo could not be read. Take a new photo and upload it.
rejected.processing_failed: The photo could not be processed. Upload it again.

Verification.title: Professional verification
Verification.intro: Upload photos of your national ID and your syndicate or college card for the verification team to review. The “Verified” badge appears only after approval.

stateExplain.unverified: You have not sent a verification request yet.
stateExplain.pending: We received your request and the verification team will review it. We will email you the result.
stateExplain.verified: Your professional status is verified and the badge shows on your profile.
stateExplain.rejected: Your request was not approved. Check the reason and send a new request.
stateExplain.expired: The card you were verified with has expired. Send a new request with a valid card.

credentialHints.pharmacist: Photo of your pharmacists' syndicate card and your membership number.
credentialHints.student: Photo of your college card and your university's name.

Verification.nationalIdHint: The 14 digits on your card. Stored encrypted and only ever shown masked.
Verification.legalNameArLabel: Your name as written on your national ID card
Verification.legalNameArHint: In Arabic, in the same order as on the card (at least three names). Only the verification team sees it, to compare with the card; it is not shown on your profile and cannot be changed after you submit.
Verification.privacyNote: Your photos and national ID are kept in private storage, seen only by the verification team, and every view is logged.
Verification.notAllowed: Confirm your email address first to request verification.
Verification.syndicateNumberHint: As printed on the card, digits only.
Verification.cardExpiresOnHint: If the card has one. Verification expires with it.
Verification.documentsHint: Photograph each document whole and clearly. JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB. Location and device data are removed from photos.

documentHints.national_id_front: The side with your photo and national ID number.
documentHints.syndicate_card: The side with your name and membership number.
documentHints.student_card: The side with your name and college.

Verification.consentPendingBadge: Placeholder wording, pending legal counsel's review
Verification.consentText: [Placeholder] I agree that Pharmacist Platform processes my national ID number and document photos only to verify my professional status, and that the verification team may view them. This text will be replaced with counsel-approved wording before launch.
Verification.submitted: Request received. National ID on file: {masked}
Verification.upload_network: The connection dropped during the upload. Try again.
Verification.upload_stillProcessing: The photo is still being checked. Try later or upload it again.

VerificationErrors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
VerificationErrors.network: Could not connect. Check your internet and try again.
VerificationErrors.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
VerificationErrors.already_pending: You already have a verification request under review.
VerificationErrors.national_id_in_use: This national ID number is already in use.
VerificationErrors.invalidFormat: A national ID number has 14 digits.
VerificationErrors.invalidCentury: A national ID number starts with 2 or 3.
VerificationErrors.invalidBirthDate: The birth date in the national ID number is not valid.
VerificationErrors.invalidGovernorate: The governorate code in the national ID number is not valid.
VerificationErrors.inPast: The card has expired. Use a valid card.
VerificationErrors.tooFarAhead: That date is too far ahead. Check it.
VerificationErrors.documentNotFound: Upload a photo of this document.
VerificationErrors.documentProcessing: Wait until the photo check finishes.
VerificationErrors.documentRejected: This photo was refused. Upload another one.
VerificationErrors.documentInUse: This photo was already used. Upload a new one.
VerificationErrors.nameNotArabic: Write the name in Arabic letters only, without digits or Latin letters.
VerificationErrors.nameFormat: The name has punctuation in the wrong place. Write it as on the card.
VerificationErrors.nameTooFewWords: Write at least three names, as on the card.

VerificationReasons.document_unreadable: A document photo is unclear or unreadable.
VerificationReasons.document_missing_or_wrong: A document is missing or not the one requested.
VerificationReasons.details_mismatch: The details entered do not match the documents.
VerificationReasons.credential_not_confirmed: The membership or enrolment could not be confirmed.
VerificationReasons.other: The request did not meet the verification requirements. Contact support for details.

VerificationEmail.note: If you did not request verification, contact support.

received.subject: Verification request received - Pharmacist Platform
received.heading: Your request is under review
received.body: We received your professional verification request and the verification team will review it. We will email you the result.

verified.subject: Your account is verified - Pharmacist Platform
verified.heading: Verified
verified.body: The verification team approved your request. Your profile now shows the “Verified” badge.

rejected.subject: Verification request not approved - Pharmacist Platform
rejected.heading: Your request was not approved
rejected.body: The verification team reviewed your request and did not approve it. You can send a new request once the reason is fixed.

StaffVerification.queueIntro: Requests under review, oldest first. National IDs are masked; every view of a document or a full number is logged in your name.
StaffVerification.queueEmpty: No requests are waiting for review.
StaffVerification.legalNameLabel: Name as on the ID card (as entered by the user)
StaffVerification.legalNameCompare: Compare this name with the card photo
StaffVerification.revealExplain: Showing the full number is logged in your name.
StaffVerification.documentsExplain: Photos load through links valid for 5 minutes, and every view is logged. Reload the page if a photo expired.
StaffVerification.noteHint: Staff only, never shown to the user. Up to 500 characters. Do not write the national ID.

confirm.verified: The request will be approved and the user notified. This cannot be undone.
confirm.rejected: The request will be rejected and the user told the reason. This cannot be undone.

errors.not_found: This request is not available for review.
errors.not_pending: This request has already been decided.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.

Organizations.title: My organizations
Organizations.intro: Create a page for your pharmacy or chain and invite the people who help you run it and hire for it. Jobs will be posted under the organization's name later.
Organizations.accepted: You accepted the invitation and are now a member.
Organizations.empty: You are not a member of any organization yet. Create one or accept an invitation.
Organizations.createExplain: You will be the owner. You can change the details later.
Organizations.nameHint: As shown on the sign, 2 to 120 characters.
Organizations.addressHint: Optional. The main branch's address, not your home address.
Organizations.notVerifiedNote: Details as entered by the organization's members; not reviewed by the platform.
Organizations.removeConfirm: Remove this member? They will lose access to the organization.
Organizations.inviteExplain: The invitation appears to the owner of this address once they sign in with it, and we email them about it. Invitations expire after 7 days.
Organizations.inviteEmailHint: The invitee must sign in with this same address to accept.
Organizations.roleHint: Owner: everything, including members and invitations. Recruiter: jobs and applications only.
Organizations.recruiterNote: Details, members and invitations are managed by the organization's owners. You will manage jobs once they are available.
Organizations.leaveConfirm: Leave this organization? You will need a new invitation to come back.

OrganizationErrors.tooLong: The text is longer than allowed.
OrganizationErrors.invalidChoice: Choose a value from the list.
OrganizationErrors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
OrganizationErrors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
OrganizationErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
OrganizationErrors.notFound: We could not find this item; it may have changed or been removed. Refresh the page.
OrganizationErrors.limitReached: You have reached the limit. Try again later or contact support.
OrganizationErrors.lastOwner: An organization needs at least one owner. Make another member an owner first.
OrganizationErrors.alreadyMember: This address already belongs to a member.
OrganizationErrors.alreadyInvited: There is already a pending invitation for this address.
OrganizationErrors.invitationClosed: This invitation is no longer available. It may have expired or been revoked.
OrganizationErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
OrganizationErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

invited.subject: Invitation to join {organization} - Pharmacist Platform
invited.heading: You have been invited to an organization
invited.body: You were invited to join “{organization}” as {role} on the Pharmacist Platform.
invited.expiry: Sign in with this email address to accept or decline. The invitation is valid for {days} days.
invited.note: If you did not expect this invitation, ignore this email; nothing changes in your account.

JobEmail.note: This message is about a job you posted on the Pharmacist Platform for your organization.

approved.subject: “{title}” is published - Pharmacist Platform
approved.heading: Job approved
approved.body: The platform team reviewed “{title}” and approved it. It is now published for 30 days.

rejected.subject: “{title}” was not published - Pharmacist Platform
rejected.heading: Job not approved
rejected.body: The platform team reviewed “{title}” and did not approve it. You can edit it and submit it for review again.

expired.subject: “{title}” has expired - Pharmacist Platform
expired.heading: Job expired
expired.body: “{title}” has expired and no longer appears on the job board. You can copy it into a new draft and publish it again.

JobRejectReasons.incomplete: The job details are incomplete or unclear.
JobRejectReasons.misleading_or_fraud: The post is misleading or looks fraudulent.
JobRejectReasons.not_pharmacy_related: The job is not related to pharmacy work.
JobRejectReasons.contact_details_in_text: The description contains phone numbers or emails; applicants will contact you through the platform.
JobRejectReasons.other: The post does not follow the platform's guidelines.

Jobs.listIntro: Jobs created by the organization's members. The platform reviews the first job before it is published.
Jobs.listEmpty: No jobs yet. Create the organization's first job.
Jobs.newIntro: Enter the job details and save a draft, then send it for publication from the job page. Do not write phone numbers or email addresses; applicants will contact you through the platform.
Jobs.titleHint: 4 to 120 characters, for example: Morning-shift pharmacist.
Jobs.temporaryHint: For a temporary job, set the start and end dates.
Jobs.areaHint: Optional. For example: Dokki, or Tahrir Street. Up to 120 characters.
Jobs.descriptionHint: 30 to 4,000 characters: duties, hours and requirements. No phone numbers or email addresses.
Jobs.minYearsHint: A number from 0 to 40. Leave empty or write 0 if no experience is required.
Jobs.salaryHint: Optional. Egyptian pounds per month, whole numbers.

statusHints.draft: A draft that has not been sent yet. Send it for publication when it is complete.
statusHints.pending_review: Waiting for the platform team's review. We will email you the result.
statusHints.published: Published and visible to everyone on the jobs page.
statusHints.paused: Paused and hidden from visitors. You can resume it.
statusHints.closed: Closed and cannot be reopened. You can create a new copy of it.
statusHints.expired: Its publication period has ended. You can create a new copy of it.
statusHints.rejected: Not accepted for publication. Edit it and send it again.

Jobs.readOnlyNote: Job details cannot be edited once sent. To correct them, create a new copy.

submitted.pending_review: The job was sent for review. It will be published after the platform team approves it.

Jobs.resumedExpired: The job's publication period ended while it was paused, so it is no longer published.
Jobs.closeConfirm: Close this job? Visitors will no longer see it and it cannot be reopened.
Jobs.copied: A new draft copy was created.
Jobs.deleteConfirm: Delete this job permanently? This cannot be undone.
Jobs.boardIntro: Jobs at pharmacies and chains in Egypt. Search by word or filter by governorate and type.
Jobs.searchHint: A word from the job title or the district.
Jobs.resultsEmpty: No matching jobs right now. Try changing your search.
Jobs.notReviewed: The organization is not reviewed by the platform; its details are as entered by its members.

JobErrors.tooLong: The text is longer than allowed.
JobErrors.invalidChoice: Choose a value from the list.
JobErrors.outOfRange: The number is outside the allowed range.
JobErrors.inPast: The date cannot be in the past.
JobErrors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
JobErrors.periodTooLong: The period is longer than the allowed maximum of one year.
JobErrors.salaryOrder: The maximum pay is lower than the minimum.
JobErrors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
JobErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
JobErrors.notFound: We could not find this item; it may have changed or been removed. Refresh the page.
JobErrors.invalidState: This action is not possible in the job's current state. Refresh the page.
JobErrors.limitReached: The organization has reached its limit of open jobs. Close a job or delete a draft and try again.
JobErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
JobErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

StaffJobs.queueIntro: Jobs waiting for review, oldest first. Reject jobs that contain phone numbers or emails or look fraudulent.
StaffJobs.queueEmpty: No jobs are waiting for review.
StaffJobs.noteHint: For staff only; the job's owner does not see it. Up to 500 characters.

confirm.approved: The job will be published immediately and its owner notified. This cannot be undone.
confirm.rejected: The job will be rejected and its owner told the reason. This cannot be undone.

ApplicationEmail.note: This message is about an application you made on the Pharmacist Platform.

shortlisted.subject: You are shortlisted for “{title}”
shortlisted.heading: You are shortlisted
shortlisted.body: The employer added your application for “{title}” to the shortlist. They may contact you soon.

accepted.subject: Your application for “{title}” was accepted
accepted.heading: Application accepted
accepted.body: The employer accepted your application for “{title}” and will contact you about next steps.

rejected.subject: Update on your application for “{title}”
rejected.heading: Application not selected
rejected.body: The employer decided not to continue with your application for “{title}”. We wish you luck with other opportunities on the platform.

Applications.title: My applications
Applications.intro: The jobs you applied to and where each application stands. You get an email when you are shortlisted, accepted or not selected.
Applications.empty: You have not applied to any job yet.
Applications.jobNoLongerLive: This job is no longer published.
Applications.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw your application? The employer will keep only your name and career stage with the status “withdrawn”; they will no longer see your phone, profile or note. You cannot apply to this job again.
Applications.signedOut: Sign in with your confirmed account to apply for this job.
Applications.noProfile: Your professional profile is what the employer sees when you apply, so create it first and then come back.
Applications.ownOrganization: This job belongs to an organization you are a member of, so you cannot apply to it.
Applications.closed: Applications for this job are not open right now.
Applications.alreadyApplied: You have already applied to this job.
Applications.shareProfile: Your public profile as it is now: name, headline, career stage, years of experience, governorate, specialties and experience. Later edits to your profile are not shown to them.
Applications.sharePhoneRule: Your phone number, only if you choose to share it below.
Applications.shareNever: Your email address is never shown to them.
Applications.coverNoteLabel: A short note to the employer (optional)
Applications.coverNoteHint: Up to {max} characters. Do not include sensitive details.
Applications.sharePhoneLabel: Share my phone number with this employer
Applications.noPhoneHint: If you want the employer to call you, add your phone number in the private details of <link>your profile</link>, then come back here.
Applications.employerIntro: People who applied to this job, oldest first.
Applications.employerEmpty: No one has applied to this job yet.
Applications.noMoves: There are no further actions for this application.

moveConfirm.accepted: The application will be accepted and the applicant emailed. This cannot be undone.
moveConfirm.rejected: The application will be rejected and the applicant emailed. This cannot be undone.

moved.shortlisted: The application was added to the shortlist.

Applications.snapshotNote: This is what the applicant shared when applying; it may differ from their current profile.
Applications.noPhoneShared: The applicant did not share a phone number.
Applications.noCoverNote: The applicant did not write a note.
Applications.withdrawnRedacted: The applicant withdrew this application. What they shared (phone, profile and note) is no longer available to you.

ApplicationErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action. Make sure your email is confirmed and that you are not a member of the job's organization.
ApplicationErrors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
ApplicationErrors.notFound: We could not find this item; it may have changed or been removed. Refresh the page.
ApplicationErrors.invalidState: This action is not possible in the application's current state. Refresh the page.
ApplicationErrors.limitReached: You have reached the daily limit of 30 applications. Try again tomorrow.
ApplicationErrors.noProfile: Create your professional profile first, then apply.
ApplicationErrors.alreadyApplied: You have already applied to this job.
ApplicationErrors.jobClosed: Applications for this job have closed.
ApplicationErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
ApplicationErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
ApplicationErrors.tooLong: The note is longer than allowed.

StaffRoles.title: Staff roles
StaffRoles.intro: Staff accounts and their roles. Grant a role to an existing account with a verified email, or revoke one.
StaffRoles.signOutNote: Any change to a person's roles signs them out on every device. They must sign in again.
StaffRoles.selfNote: This is your account. Nobody changes their own roles, so another super admin must do it.
StaffRoles.revokeConfirm: Revoke this role from the account? The person will be signed out everywhere.
StaffRoles.emailHint: The account must already exist and have a verified email.

result.granted: The role was granted. The person was signed out everywhere.
result.revoked: The role was revoked. The person was signed out everywhere.
result.unchanged: Nothing changed: the account already had this state.

StaffRoleErrors.forbidden: You are not allowed to manage staff roles.
StaffRoleErrors.validation: Enter a valid email and choose a role.
StaffRoleErrors.emailNotVerified: This account's email is not verified yet.
StaffRoleErrors.selfChange: You cannot change your own roles.
StaffRoleErrors.lastSuperAdmin: At least one super admin must remain. Grant the role to someone else first.
StaffRoleErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
StaffRoleErrors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

StaffAudit.title: Audit log
StaffAudit.intro: A read-only record of staff actions, newest first. It holds codes and ids, never names or documents.
